notice: DEMO FIXTURE — synthetic data only. Seed groups below are curated for the demo and created through the public API by the reviewer handle 'demo.seed'. Request texts are read from data/synthetic/requests.jsonl (runtime inputs, no labels). Nothing here is used by runtime matching.

groups.title: Dark mode
groups.needStatement: People working in low light want a darker appearance that is comfortable for their eyes.

groups.title: Fewer, consolidated notifications
groups.needStatement: Users receive so many individual notifications that they ignore them; they need fewer, bundled updates.

groups.title: Single sign-on and central access control
groups.needStatement: IT needs sign-in and access removal to be controlled centrally through the company identity provider.

groups.title: Invoices flow into accounting
groups.needStatement: Finance staff need invoice data to reach their accounting system without manual re-entry.

groups.title: Safeguards against forgotten timers
groups.needStatement: Time entries become wrong when people forget to stop timers; they need reminders or automatic safeguards.

groups.title: Edit many tasks at once
groups.needStatement: Users need to apply the same change to many existing tasks instead of editing them one by one.
